Submitted on 3 Jan 2026 (v1), last revised 10 Feb 2026 (this version, v2)

Authors: Ada Moss, Wei Lin

## Abstract

Survey answers bunch at round numbers. We measure the bunching in three household surveys and propose a correction that spreads each round answer over its neighbours.

- Comments: 12 pages, 3 figures
